messages:
incident-bot: Pager: THROTTLE_SURGE detected for pool=dedicated-us-west-2. Throttle rate >10% for 3m, tokens/sec spike. Paging oncall.
sam oncall: I’m on it. Looking at dashboard — queue depth rising on gpu-pool-7.
alex_infra: Confirmed. tokens/sec jumped from ~120k to ~480k in 2m, KV cache hit down 22%.
maria_sre: Any customer impact reports yet? rachel_ce, any tickets
rachel_ce: One customer (acct-394) DM'd about increased 429s. I'll pull details.
sam oncall: Starting live mitigation — will scale pool target +20% and increase max nodes temporarily. Pushing now.
alex_infra: Command I ran: ```./infractl scale --pool gpu-pool-7 --target 24 --max 36``` monitor autoscaler.
kyung_mlops: Adding: throttles correlate with long-seq requests. Can we route long-context to fallback-medium model while we stabilize?
jordan_rt: 👍 will add route rule to routing-layer: `if seq_len>4096 -> model:medium-compat` — pushing in 30s.
incident-bot: Autoscaler: scale request accepted for gpu-pool-7 -> target=24. New nodes provisioning.
sam oncall: Noting handoff in 10m, may need to step out. Maria can take lead if still active.
maria_sre: Taking lead. I’ll watch for residual queue growth and adjust autoscale cooldown if needed.
rachel_ce: Customer acct-394 reports rate improved after ~6m but still sees occasional 429s.
alex_infra: Node joins delayed by new instance type warmup (nvlink). Temp mitigation: reduce batch window to 10ms to cut latency and drop queue pressure.
kyung_mlops: Quick change: ```sed -i 's/batch_window_ms: 50/batch_window_ms: 10/' /etc/serving/configs/gpu-pool-7.yaml && rollout restart svc/serving-gpu7``` — done.
jordan_rt: Route rule applied. Traffic for long-seq moved ~22% off high-throughput pool.
incident-bot: Alert resolved: THROTTLE_SURGE cleared for pool=dedicated-us-west-2. Throttle rate <3% for 4m.
sam oncall: Back online. Thanks team. Immediate actions: scale reverted to previous safe target in 15m, batch_window left at 10ms as mitigation until postmortem.
maria_sre: Post-incident tuning notes: 1) increase queue_depth alert threshold from 1000 -> 1500? 2) add short-window burst detector (1m) for tokens/sec alerts 3) add dashboard panel for long-seq routing splits. Thoughts?
alex_infra: Agree on burst detector. Also lower tokens/sec alert threshold for dedicated pools from 200k -> 180k for early warning.
kyung_mlops: We should also add an alert for KV cache miss rate >15% — that preceeded the surge here.
jordan_rt: I'll create a dashboard tile and a routing failover test runbook.
rachel_ce: Customer follow-up: I’ll send status to acct-394 and ask for any remaining errors, offer a brief SLA credit draft if needed.
maria_sre: Filed follow-ups: SRE-7884 (alert changes), INFRA-4521 (scale warmup playbooks), ROUTE-330 (long-seq fallback smoke tests). Assigning owners tomorrow.
sam oncall: Solid. Closing thread and will add to next oncall retro. :thumbsup:
